mumu.title: Install MuMu Player
mumu.text: An Android phone emulator, to run the Vinhomes app on the PC.

windows.text: After every run, dry runs too, the corner of the screen shows the play day and each slot with its court or why it was not booked. It uses the language of this interface.

test.sent: Sent. Look at the bottom right of the screen.

guide.title: Guide
guide.lead: How to use each part of Court Booker.

start.title: Get started in 4 steps
start.booking: Choose the day, court and slots

screens.title: Each screen
screens.overview: The line at the top says whether the PC is ready. On the left, the "{{ticket}}" ticket: turn on "{{daily}}", choose the play day, the court and up to two slots (saved on each press), and do a dry run; while a booking goes on, the ticket shows it live. On the right, "{{history}}": each booking, which slots were booked, which were not and why; tick "{{withDry}}" to see the dry runs too. Press a row to see every step; when something goes wrong, open "{{technical}}" to see exactly what happened.
screens.settings: "{{device}}": prepare MuMu, the Vinhomes app and the PC.

notRunning.question: The app did not run this morning
notRunning.answer: Usually the PC was shut down instead of put to Sleep, or you signed out of Windows. The PC can only wake itself up from Sleep.

slotFull.question: The result says "{{slotFull}}"
slotFull.answer: Someone booked that slot first, or you booked it yourself by hand with another account. You can choose other slots in {{slotsPlace}}.

quota.question: The Vinhomes app says the flat has used up its bookings
quota.answer: Each flat can book up to 8 slots a month. Cancel the bookings you do not need in the Vinhomes app to book again.

loggedOut.question: The Vinhomes app was logged out
loggedOut.answer: The result says "{{loggedOut}}". Open the app in MuMu, log in again with the resident account, then do one dry run in {{dryRunPlace}}.

setup.question: {{device}} says "{{todo}}"
setup.answer: Follow the instructions of that item, then press "{{check}}". For the items Court Booker does itself, press "{{auto}}".

intro.title: Book a tennis court at {{start}}, even while you sleep
intro.lead: The Vinhomes app opens bookings at {{start}} every morning and the good slots are gone in seconds. Court Booker taps for you, in the very first second.

wake.title: The PC wakes itself up
wake.text: From Sleep, without you turning it on.

open.title: Opens MuMu and the Vinhomes app
open.text: Then waits on the Sân Tennis page.

book.title: Books the slots you chose
book.text: Two slots usually take about 15 seconds, then MuMu closes.
